description: Pre-built operational factories that can be instantiated, configured, measured, and cloned without creating a new architecture for every workflow.

blueprints.role: bounded offer, checkout, fulfilment and reconciliation operations

guardrails: A factory never becomes authoritative merely because an LLM says it succeeded.
Every material run produces observable state and evidence references.
Negative signals are retained and can create new guardrails.
Synthesized signals remain derived, not canonical truth.
Triangulation records its independent source ancestry.
External financial actions remain behind existing economic authority gates.
Autonomy is bounded by blueprint ceiling, instance setting, budget, action count and kill switch.
Promotion remains separate from execution and requires the existing promotion gate.
